name: Belonger Status by Long-Term Residence (15 Years)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 15 years of continuous residence in Anguilla, proven via a sworn affidavit from a Notary Public stating the average time spent in Anguilla for each year within the 15-year period, plus two affidavits from established Anguillians confirming residency, old passports, and work permits.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 15 years of continuous residence in Anguilla.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a police certificate and a health certificate.

evidence_required.document: Sworn affidavit (Notary Public) on average time spent in Anguilla per year over the 15-year period
Two affidavits from established Anguillians confirming residency

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 15 years of continuous residence, evidenced year-by-year

sources.title: Government of Anguilla -- Anguilla Status (Belonger Status): descent/parentage, marriage (5 years), and residence (15 years) grounds, documents, and fees

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Anguilla's initial build. See ai_belonger_status_descent.json's notes for why leads_to_citizenship is modelled as false. FLAGGED, NOT MODELLED: the Immigration Forms page (gov_ai_immigration_forms, cited in ai_belonger_status_descent.json) lists a form titled 'Belonger Status - Born in Anguilla and resident for 10 or 15 years', implying a shorter 10-year path for applicants actually born in Anguilla -- but the substantive Anguilla Status page content fetched in this pass only described the general 15-year continuous-residence ground and did not detail a separate born-in-Anguilla/10-year variant. Rather than guess at the terms of that shorter path, only the confirmed 15-year general-residence ground is modelled here; the possible 10-year variant is an open gap for a future pass with a source that details it.
